Good afternoon. Thank you for joining us for our Q3 2020 earnings call.
I'm the Chief Executive Officer of LLY.
Customer acquisition exceeded our targets with 1111 thousand new accounts added in the quarter.
We anticipate margins may be impacted by approximately 56 basis points pending supplier contract renewals.
I'll now turn the call over to our CFO for a more detailed financial review.
Thank you. Our Chief Financial Officer will now provide the financial details for Q3 2020.
Our gross margin expanded by 56 basis points to 51.9%, reflecting improved operational efficiency.
We expect revenues to grow approximately 18% to 7% next quarter, subject to market conditions.
We will now begin the question-and-answer session.
Analyst - First question:
How should we think about the cadence of revenue recognition in the second half?
Thank you for the question. Our gross margin expanded by 56 basis points to 51.9%, reflecting improved operational efficiency.
Second question - Analyst:
Could you quantify the FX headwind embedded in your guidance?
While we remain optimistic, there can be no assurance that macroeconomic headwinds won't affect demand.
